name: keystone_coreserv_open_sub_account

The confirm step is irreversible and pauses for human approval on every execution. Returns the host confirmation message. Returns: confirmation (string). Possible business outcomes (not errors): RECORD_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_REJECTED, OPTION_UNAVAILABLE. Risk: irreversible - irreversible steps pause for human approval. name: keystone_coreserv_open_sub_account_review
description: Prepare new member sub-account and stop at review screen. Given a member number, product type, nickname, opening deposit amount, and funding suffix code, this capability searches Member Inquiry for the member, opens the OPEN SUB-ACCOUNT form from the member detail screen, fills in the product, nickname, opening deposit and funding suffix, and submits CONTINUE to land on the REVIEW NEW SUB-ACCOUNT confirmation screen. It stops before the irreversible CONFIRM AND OPEN step, outputting the review screen for human verification. Returns: none. Possible business outcomes (not errors): RECORD_NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, VALIDATION_REJECTED, OPTION_UNAVAILABLE. Risk: safe.
